item.title: Welcome to Singlestep
item.description: This is the first post on Singlestep — a personal engineering knowledge base built
item.content:encoded:
This is the first post on Singlestep — a personal engineering knowledge base built around interactive simulations.

The first hero demo is Redis read modes. Toggle between master and replica reads and watch where the requests go. It's the kind of thing that takes ten minutes to read about and three seconds to understand once you can see it.

More to come — Kafka consumer rebalancing, cache eviction policies, transaction propagation. If a topic confused you the first time you learned it, that's exactly the kind of thing that gets a sim here.
